title: California Ship Registry, 1769–1846: A Documentary Register of Vessel Visits to the Californias
description: The first machine-readable registry of documented vessel visits to the Californias, 1769–1846. The unit of record is the visit (one vessel, one anchorage, one time), each row carrying manuscript-leaf citations with deep links to page scans. Seeded from the Archives of California calendar of the Savage transcripts (BANC MSS C-A) and corroborated against Bancroft's History of California and Adele Ogden's trading-vessel itineraries. Publishes its refusals: a seven-class false-ship taxonomy with the guards that catch each. Entries graded draft → reviewed → verified.
